issues.title: Display geometry name on polygons
issues.body:
For a selected set of orders [*], we should display the "geometry name" in the polygon, or next to the marker point.

[*] we don't have orders yet

comments.body: could you provide some screenshots on this task @IanMayo ?

The `Orders` objects aren't being rendered, so I have a PR in that makes them render:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/196205592-64b6f3e0-2d3f-42cc-978a-db290b01b924.png)

The issue here is that I wish the name of the polygon to be permanently visible at it's centre.  This is like how we display the name of the activity for polylines.

Once the `render orders ` [PR](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/1932) is done, there will be at least two polygons on the screen (as shown above).  These polygons are generated in `SharedOrderRenderer.tsx` - in the `Polygon` block of `shapeFor`.

Here is a react component which shows. a div-icon.  I _think_ that DivIcon is the way of permanently showing a span of text on the map:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-leaflet-div-icon
